layout.arrangement: White slide margin surrounding a full-size light-gray panel outlined with a thin dark-red border. Title sits top center-right with a small yellow numbered badge '24' in the top-right corner. Directly below the title on the right is a white dashed-blue-bordered box containing the example sentence. The left ~55% of the panel is filled by one very large pale-cyan circle with a dashed blue border containing a fully-connected word-attention graph (6 word nodes, red arrows, small blue vector icons). The right side shows the output of the operation: a large hatched block arrow pointing right, a green 'Boy' node with an orange vector icon (top right), and a second green 'Boy' node with a blue vector icon (bottom center-right) linked to the orange vector by a red dashed line.

layout.hierarchy: The title is the largest text. The left attention circle dominates by area. Most visually salient colors are the red arrows, the green 'Boy' nodes, and the dashed blue borders. Node labels are bold and larger than the sentence text; the '24' badge is small. The right-side result graphic is sparser and reads as the 'conclusion' of the left diagram.

visual_elements.description: Self-attention word graph inside one huge pale-cyan circle with dashed dark-blue border. Six circular word nodes: 'in' (top-left), 'garden' (top-right), 'the' (mid-left), 'Boy' (center, the only green node), 'tree' (mid-right), 'climbs' (bottom). Red arrows (mostly double-headed, thickness varies ~2-4pt, suggesting attention weights) connect: in<->garden; in<->the; in<->Boy [?]; the<->garden [?]; the<->Boy; the<->tree (long diagonal crossing the circle); Boy<->garden (THICK); Boy<->tree (thick); Boy<->climbs (thick, near-vertical); climbs<->tree [?]; garden<->tree (THICK, along right edge). Next to five of the nodes are small 'embedding vector' icons: rounded rectangles with blue outlines containing 4 stacked short horizontal light-blue bars, placed beside 'in' (left, outside circle edge), 'the' (lower-left), 'Boy' (right, inside circle), 'climbs' (right), 'tree' (below); 'garden' has no visible vector icon [?].
visual_elements.position: left half of slide, x ~4-54%, y ~9-98%

visual_elements.description: Large right-pointing block arrow (PowerPoint 'Block Arrow: Right' style) with red outline and pink diagonal-hatch pattern fill, indicating transformation of the left graph into the right-side result.

Output/result graphic: (a) top-right green circle labeled 'Boy' (light green fill, darker green border) with an orange vector icon at its lower right — a rounded rectangle with orange-red outline containing 4 stacked horizontal orange bars (the new contextual embedding); (b) bottom green circle labeled 'Boy' (same style) with a blue vector icon at its lower right (rounded rectangle, blue outline, 4 light-blue bars — the original input embedding); (c) a thin red DASHED line connecting the bottom Boy's blue vector diagonally up-right to the orange vector, showing the input embedding being mapped to the output embedding.
Example-sentence callout: white rectangle with dashed dark-blue border containing the sentence 'The boy climbs the tree in the garden', with the word 'boy' bolded.

colors.background: #E9E9E9 light-gray panel with #FFFFFF outer margin and #C00000 thin red panel border

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title: bold, ~28-30pt, black, mixed case. Node labels: bold, ~16-18pt. Example sentence: regular weight ~16-18pt with the single word 'boy' bolded for emphasis. Slide number: ~14-16pt regular. No italics, no bullet lists, no all-caps. Emphasis is achieved via bolding, color fills, and line thickness rather than font changes.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — no partial bullet/element reveal. The small pen icon resting on the garden<->tree arrow indicates the presenter was live-annotating when the frame was captured; it is not a build state.
